aboutIntro: Clozest helps you book a time at a salon near you, and helps local salons take bookings online.
aboutFind: Find salons within {km} km of you, with their services, prices, offers and opening hours.
aboutBook: Pick your services and a free time, and book in a few taps. You get a start code for the salon.
aboutMove: Move or cancel a booking from the app, and get a message when the salon changes anything.
aboutFreeAfter: You pay the salon for its services at the salon, as you do today. Clozest takes no payment from customers.
aboutWhere: Hyderabad, Telangana, starting with a few areas and growing from there.
